mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT b.* FROM bank b JOIN share s ON s.bank_id = b.id LEFT JOIN share_member m ON m.share_id = s.id AND m.user_id = #{userId} WHERE (s.to_user_id = #{userId} OR (s.share_type = 4 AND s.from_user_id != #{userId})) AND (m.id IS NULL OR m.subscribed = 1) ORDER BY b.id DESC
SELECT * FROM bank WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND name = #{name}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bank (name, description, origin_bank_id, user_id) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{originBankId}, #{userId})
